request.task: Corrected Canvas final security evidence audit

findings.title: OBX-AUTH-ATF-001 path-cage and authority-capability breach
findings.evidence: The 83-path census includes docs/plans/one-box-master/00-authority/authority-manifest.json. Allowed prefixes are src/lib/aiTeammates/, src/app/api/ai-teammates/, src/components/preview/AiTeammate/; exact paths and supportingEvidencePrefixes do not include this file. prohibitedCapabilities lists authority; invalidators include scope-expansion.
findings.remediation: Revert or exclude authority-manifest.json from the synthetic target, or amend OBX-AUTH-ATF-001 before any change. Re-run path-cage proof against the literal allow-lists and recapture the census.

findings.title: exactModel gate failed
findings.evidence: requiredReview.exactModel is x-ai/grok-4.6. The review JSON has no model attestation. Receipt transportNote states two exact-Grok security requests were rejected and this is local substitute evidence.
findings.remediation: Regenerate the security review with x-ai/grok-4.6 on the bound tree, record model/request ids in the report, and invalidate any local PASS used as exact-model closure.

findings.title: independentVerification gate unmet
findings.evidence: requiredReview.independentVerification is true. The bundle is self-attesting: same receipt, command log, and PASS report with findings []. No separate verifier identity, independent report, or dissenting review is bound.
findings.remediation: Commission an independent verifier on the frozen synthetic tree and hash-bind that report separately from the implementation evidence.

findings.title: Census is circular and not independently captured
findings.evidence: CMD-001 records only “83 paths” and points at the report’s changed_paths/captured_diff_paths. Command evidence does not list the paths. Those arrays match each other, but git output is not reproduced, so the census cannot be checked outside the report.
findings.remediation: Paste the exact git diff --name-only listing into command evidence, hash-bind it, and require byte-for-byte equality with both path arrays.

findings.title: Prohibited-capability scan is fail-open and under-scoped
findings.evidence: CMD-004 uses rg … || true, so exit 0 is guaranteed. Scope is only src/app/api/ai-teammates, src/lib/aiTeammates, src/components/preview/AiTeammate. Census shared files Workbench.tsx and scripts/e2e/canvas-contract.mjs were not scanned despite prohibitedCapabilityScanRequired.
findings.remediation: Drop || true, fail closed on scanner errors, and scan every changed runtime/shared path including Workbench.tsx and canvas-contract.mjs.

findings.title: sharedFileDiffReviewRequired not evidenced
findings.evidence: Shared exact-path diffs include Workbench.tsx, workbench.css, docs/architecture/README.md, local-api-threat-model.md, and canvas-contract.mjs. sourceIntegrity hashes only route.ts, LocalAiTeammatePanel.tsx, and the threat-model doc. No per-hunk shared-file review is present.
findings.remediation: Publish a shared-file diff review with before/after hashes for every allowedExactPath change and extend sourceIntegrity to those files.

findings.title: Coverage citations bind the wrong command-evidence lines
findings.evidence: prompt-injection cites :30 (heading), export/export_policy cite :32 (authn/authz paragraph), empty-surface rows cite :33 (untrusted-input). Prompt-injection is :34, export :36, audit-only :37. CMD-003 cites :20 (heading); CMD-004 cites :24 (blank).
findings.remediation: Retarget every citation to the supporting sentence and re-run the report validator.

findings.title: targetChangeInvalidatesReview is not closed
findings.evidence: Review is bound to edaa6c75 / tree 45850628 and an 83-path census, but currentWorktreeSecretsScan copied 86 changed/untracked files excluding the receipt. Extra paths are unnamed, so a dirty worktree could include runtime changes that invalidate the review.
findings.remediation: Name the extra files, prove they are evidence-only, or recapture against a clean tree identical to syntheticTree.

findings.title: Validator claim is unreproducible
findings.evidence: report.validator is python3 /Users/zero-suminc./.codex/skills/security-review/scripts/validate_report.py --report <report> exited 0. Placeholder path, machine-local script, no validator digest or argv.
findings.remediation: Record the real report path, validator script hash/version, full argv, and stdout, and bind them in the receipt.

audit.proof_assessment: Internal 83-path arrays agree and six surfaces are labeled, but closure fails literal OBX-AUTH-ATF-001 (authority-manifest.json), exact-model, and independent-verification gates. Capability scan is fail-open and misses shared files; census, citations, validator, and dirty 86-file worktree are not independently checkable. PASS/0 findings is not supported.
residual_risks: This paper audit cannot recompute claimed SHA-256 bindings.
Same-origin fetch versus prohibitedCapabilities.network remains a policy ambiguity.
prompt-injection NOT-APPLICABLE despite a 1–2000 character task field.
LocalAiTeammatePanel.tsx is a changed sensitive surface without a dedicated test file in CMD-003.
Future target drift still invalidates this synthetic-tree review.
